title: Pokémon XY Evolutions Card Collection + Prismatic Evolutions Eevee Binder
description:
Nice collection of Pokémon cards from the popular XY Evolutions set, stored in an Eevee Prismatic Evolutions 9-pocket binder.

Includes a good mix of Pokémon and Trainer cards, with regular cards and reverse holos throughout.

Cards shown include Growlithe, Arcanine, Poliwag, Staryu, Magikarp, Nidoran, Nidorino, Nidoking, Gastly, Haunter, Drowzee, Koffing, Sandshrew, Diglett, Machop, Machoke, Onix, Hitmonchan, Misty’s Determination, Pidgeot Spirit Link and more.

There are duplicates of a number of cards, making this a good lot for an Evolutions collector, someone working towards the set, or anyone wanting older-style Pokémon artwork.

Eevee Prismatic Evolutions binder is included with the sale.
